native_specs.name: 130 | 01 Every quiz page → Your Instagram inbox
native_specs.description: Ordered 7-day native funnel from the exact first Welcome after public release. Every quiz screen is required; the last step is the real inbox reveal, which also confirms connection. No optional steps can inflate conversion. Same saved release cutoff and test/reviewer exclusions as the dashboard.

properties.key:
(person_id, timestamp) IN (
WITH first_welcome AS (
    SELECT person_id, min(timestamp) AS started,
           argMin(toString(properties.build), timestamp) AS first_build
    FROM events
    WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-08-01 00:00:00')
      AND event = 'onboarding_screen_viewed' AND properties.screen_id = 's1'
    GROUP BY person_id
), excluded AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT person_id
    FROM events
    WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-08-01 00:00:00')
      AND (properties.is_test_build = true OR properties.onboarding_preview = true
        OR (timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-09-18 00:00:00')
            AND timestamp < toDateTime('2026-09-21 04:11:22')
            AND toInt(properties.build) BETWEEN 109 AND 116)
        -- Preserve the project's existing Apple-review traffic heuristic.
        OR (properties.build IS NOT NULL AND properties.$geoip_country_code = 'US'
            AND (properties.$geoip_city_name = 'Cupertino'
              OR empty(toString(coalesce(properties.$geoip_subdivision_1_code, ''))))))
), cohort AS (
    SELECT person_id, started
    FROM first_welcome
    WHERE first_build = '130'
      AND notEmpty(coalesce((SELECT toString(variables.`01a0e0dc-d8fa-0000-8098-d0a7a7303754`.value) FROM system.dashboards WHERE id = 2140017), ''))
      AND started >= toDateTime(if(empty(coalesce((SELECT toString(variables.`01a0e0dc-d8fa-0000-8098-d0a7a7303754`.value) FROM system.dashboards WHERE id = 2140017), '')), '2100-01-01 00:00:00', coalesce((SELECT toString(variables.`01a0e0dc-d8fa-0000-8098-d0a7a7303754`.value) FROM system.dashboards WHERE id = 2140017), '')))
      AND person_id NOT IN (SELECT person_id FROM excluded)
)
SELECT person_id, started FROM cohort
)
